The most prominent of these firms is the Danila Group, which developed the renowned MAID series of construct soldiers. These MAIDs are unique in their ability to perform both domestic家政 and combat roles, seamlessly transitioning from household duties during the day to potentially dangerous missions, such as raiding convoys or assassinations, in the evening.
